name: native-reason-manifest-memory
goal: Retain only reason-relevant manifest declarations across source history

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Historical reason sides still retain every active full ComponentManifest although requiredReasons uses only unit identity, status, source paths and declared configuration digest.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/history-reason-steps.e2e.test.ts asserts compact side and source-file facts but does not inspect manifest shape; extend its 32-revision scenario to require compact reason manifests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The 32-revision scenario failed on cf81ce11b0c193a9e966774edcd29e08147ca0c5 because historical manifests retain fields beyond declarationHash, id, owns and status.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 65ff00fe35 keeps only unit identity, owned paths and declared configuration fingerprints in historical reason sides.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged history and in-memory compatibility tests passed 5 of 5 on 65ff00fe35eb6e3887461ff2bc244f1b01e67008 on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
